blocks.prompt: 17 Solve the following trigonometric equation: \(\sin 3x\cos x + \cos 3x\sin x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\)
blocks.explanation:
Left side ko pehchaniye: "sin cos + cos sin" ka pattern \(\sin(A + B)\) ka formula hai. Formula pehchan lena hi is sawal ki chaabi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(\sin 3x\cos x + \cos 3x\sin x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Find kya karna hai? \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Rule: addition formula \(\sin(A + B) = \sin A\cos B + \cos A\sin B\).
Plan: left side ko \(\sin 4x\) banana, angle \(4x\) ke jawab likhna, phir 4 se divide kar ke \([0, 2\pi]\) wali values ginna.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\sin 3x\cos x + \cos 3x\sin x = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\).
Maloom karna: \([0, 2\pi]\) mein solutions aur general solution.
Tareeqa: \(\sin(A + B) = \sin A\cos B + \cos A\sin B\), jahan \(A = 3x\) aur \(B = x\). Expand karne ke bajaye ulta kaam karenge: lambi expression ko chhota (compress) karenge.

Addition formula lagayein
\[\sin(3x + x) = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
\[\sin 4x = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\]
Kyun: left side bilkul \(\sin(A + B)\) ki expansion hai: pehle \(\sin A\cos B\), phir plus, phir \(\cos A\sin B\). To poori expression ek hi term \(\sin 4x\) ban gayi.

Angle \(4x\) ke liye hal karein
\[4x = \tfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\]
\[4x = \pi - \tfrac{\pi}{4} + 2n\pi = \tfrac{3\pi}{4} + 2n\pi\]
Kyun: sine positive hai to angle pehle (I) ya doosre (II) quadrant mein hai. Reference angle \(\frac{\pi}{4}\) hai kyunke \(\sin\frac{\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\). Doosre quadrant ka angle \(\pi - \frac{\pi}{4}\) hota hai. Sine ka period \(2\pi\).
Doosre quadrant wala jawab bhoolna sab se aam ghalti hai; sine ki har positive value ke ek chakkar mein do angles hote hain.

4 se divide karein
\[x = \tfrac{\pi}{16} + \tfrac{n\pi}{2}\]
\[x = \tfrac{3\pi}{16} + \tfrac{n\pi}{2}\]
Kyun: har term ko 4 se divide kiya; \(\frac{2n\pi}{4} = \frac{n\pi}{2}\).
Dhyan dein: sirf pehli term ko divide kar ke \(2n\pi\) waisa hi chhor dena aam ghalti hai; is se bohat se jawab reh jate hain.

\([0, 2\pi]\) mein values (\(n = 0, 1, 2, 3\))
\[\tfrac{\pi}{16}, \tfrac{9\pi}{16}, \tfrac{17\pi}{16}, \tfrac{25\pi}{16}\]
\[\tfrac{3\pi}{16}, \tfrac{11\pi}{16}, \tfrac{19\pi}{16}, \tfrac{27\pi}{16}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{n\pi}{2} = \frac{8n\pi}{16}\), is liye har qadam par numerator mein 8 jurta hai. \(n = 4\) par \(2\pi = \frac{32\pi}{16}\) se aage chale jate hain. \(x\) ke ek chakkar mein \(4x\) chaar chakkar lagata hai, har chakkar mein do jawab, yani 8 values.
Dekhiye, yeh 8 values do do ke joron mein hain: \(\frac{\pi}{16}\) aur \(\frac{3\pi}{16}\), phir \(\frac{9\pi}{16}\) aur \(\frac{11\pi}{16}\), wagaira.

Tasdeeq: \(x = \frac{\pi}{16}\)
\[4x = \tfrac{\pi}{4},\quad \sin\tfrac{\pi}{4} = \tfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: left side asal mein \(\sin 4x\) hai. \(x = \frac{3\pi}{16}\) par bhi \(\sin\frac{3\pi}{4} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}\) \(\checkmark\).
